heart-attack.text: Signs of a heart attack: pain like a very tight band, heavy weight or squeezing in the centre of your chest

stroke.text: Signs of a stroke: face drooping on one side, can’t hold both arms up, difficulty speaking

breathing.text: Severe difficulty breathing: gasping, not being able to get words out, choking or lips turning blue

bleeding.text: Heavy bleeding that won’t stop, spraying or pouring

injuries.text: Severe injuries or deep cuts after a serious accident

seizure.text: A seizure (fit): shaking or jerking because of a fit, or unconscious and can’t be woken

confusion.text: Sudden confusion: can’t be sure of own name or age, slurred speech or not making sense

suicide-attempt.text: A suicide attempt by taking something or self-harming

swelling.text: Sudden, rapid swelling of the lips, mouth, throat or tongue

labour.text: Labour or childbirth: waters breaking, more frequent intense cramps, baby coming or just born

sepsis.text: Signs of a severe infection (sepsis): blue, grey, pale or blotchy skin, lips or tongue; a rash that does not fade when you roll a glass over it; or a high temperature with a stiff neck or dislike of bright light

cauda-equina.text: Back pain with numbness around your bottom or genitals, or new problems controlling your bladder or bowels

hot-joint.text: A hot, swollen joint and you feel unwell or have a high temperature

injury-weight-bearing.text: A recent injury and you can’t put weight on it, or it looks out of shape
injury-weight-bearing.action: Go to an urgent treatment centre or A&E

back-weight-loss.text: Back pain with unexplained weight loss or night sweats
back-weight-loss.action: Contact us today rather than referring yourself

infection-worsening.text: An infection that is getting worse quickly, or you feel very unwell, very sleepy or confused
infection-worsening.action: Call 111 now, or 999 if it’s an emergency
